# Legacy Projects

Manage legacy projects in Teamleader Focus — the original project system (API path projects, webhook events project.*). See Projects for the current system.

LegacyProjects — the original project system in Teamleader Focus.

The names do not line up with the class names; to be explicit:

    SDK method   Teamleader::legacyProjects()
    API path     projects.*        (the bare path belongs to the OLD system)
    Webhooks     project.created, project.updated, project.deleted

The current system is `Projects`, on the `projects-v2/projects.*` path,
with `nextgenProject.*` webhook events. So the class names and the endpoint
paths run in opposite directions: `Projects` is the newer class on the longer
path, `LegacyProjects` is the older class on the shorter one.

**Do not infer which system an account is on from whether a list call returns
rows.** Both endpoints answer. Ask directly:

    Teamleader::accounts()->getProjectsVersion();      // "projects-v2" or "legacy"
    Teamleader::accounts()->isUsingLegacyProjects();   // bool

Accounts are migrated to the new system over time;
Accounts::getAutoSwitchDate() reports when, if it is scheduled.

```php
Teamleader::legacyProjects()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Projects\LegacyProjects` |
| Create / update / delete | ✓ / ✓ / ✓ |
| Pagination | `page_size` / `page_number`; no totals — a short page is the last one. Every page: [`lazy()` / `cursor()`](../../guides/pagination.md#fetching-everything) |

- `projects.addParticipant`
- `projects.close`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `customer.id` | Customer UUID |
| `customer.type` | Customer type (contact, company) |
| `participant_id` | Filter by participant UUID |
| `status` | Project status (active, on_hold, done, cancelled) |
| `term` | Search term (searches title or description) |
| `updated_since` | ISO 8601 datetime |

## Sorting

Pass `sort` (and optionally `sort_order`) in the options. Any other field throws.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `created_at` | Sort by creation date |
| `due_on` | Sort by project due date |
| `title` | Sort by project title |

## Accepted values

Public constants on the class. Body fields and enum values outside these lists
throw before the request is sent.

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| `CREATE_FIELDS` | `title`, `description`, `starts_on`, `milestones`, `participants`, `customer`, `purchase_order_number`, `custom_fields` |
| `CURRENCIES` | `BAM`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `CLP`, `CNY`, `COP`, `CZK`, `DKK`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `INR`, `ISK`, `JPY`, `MAD`, `MXN`, `NOK`, `PEN`, `PLN`, `RON`, `SEK`, `TRY`, `USD`, `ZAR` |
| `CUSTOMER_TYPES` | `contact`, `company` |
| `ROLES` | `decision_maker`, `member` |
| `STATUSES` | `active`, `on_hold`, `done`, `cancelled` |
| `UPDATE_FIELDS` | `title`, `description`, `status`, `starts_on`, `customer`, `budget`, `purchase_order_number`, `custom_fields` |

## Methods

### `info()`

```php
info($id, $includes = null)
```

Get detailed information about a specific project

- `$id` — Project UUID
- `$includes` — Not used for legacy projects

### `create()`

```php
create(array $data): array
```

Create a new project

- `$data` — Project data

### `update()`

```php
update($id, array $data): array
```

Update an existing project

- `$id` — Project UUID
- `$data` — Project data to update

### `delete()`

```php
delete($id, ...$additionalParams): array
```

Delete a project

- `$id` — Project UUID
- `$additionalParams` — Not used for legacy projects

### `close()`

```php
close(string $id): array
```

Close a project (also closes all phases and tasks)

- `$id` — Project UUID

### `reopen()`

```php
reopen(string $id): array
```

Reopen a closed project

- `$id` — Project UUID

### `addParticipant()`

```php
addParticipant(string $id, array $participant, ?string $role = 'member'): array
```

Add a participant to a project

- `$id` — Project UUID
- `$participant` — Participant data
- `$role` — Participant role (decision_maker, member)

### `updateParticipant()`

```php
updateParticipant(string $id, array $participant, string $role): array
```

Update a participant's role in a project

- `$id` — Project UUID
- `$participant` — Participant data
- `$role` — New role (decision_maker, member)

## Examples

Get all projects:

```php
$projects = Teamleader::legacyProjects()->list();
```

Get active projects:

```php
$projects = Teamleader::legacyProjects()->active();
```

Create a new project:

```php
$project = Teamleader::legacyProjects()->create([...]);
```

Close a project:

```php
$result = Teamleader::legacyProjects()->close("project-uuid");
```

Check whether this account is on the legacy system at all:

```php
if (Teamleader::accounts()->isUsingLegacyProjects()) {
                $projects = Teamleader::legacyProjects()->list();
            } else {
                $projects = Teamleader::projects()->list();
            }
```
